what_this_proves: Byte identity of the released templates with the approved Step 2 v3 templates. It does not prove runtime behavior.

research_decisions.FAIR-01: APPROVED: preserve every enforcement, hook, checker, loading, routing and capability difference; no harmonization (benchmark_readiness_fair02_cp01_v1/FAIR01_APPROVED_DISPOSITION.md)

FAIR-02.state: ADOPTED: one external reporting instruction, identical for all six, appended to the task prompt, never embedded in a template; Report Completeness Score is secondary

research_decisions.CP-01: Option 0: M keeps IDE0005 detection through dotnet format; no GenerateDocumentationFile added; M comments not patched (CP01_CORRECTION_PROPOSAL.md)
other: CI/CD outside the practical benchmark scope
raw MUST_NOT counts are not a strictness score

runtime_dependencies.claude_code_host: Hooks use the exec form {command: node, args: [...]} with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} in args and onFailure: block on PreToolUse. Whether a given host version honors these keys is a host fact (see LIVE_HOST_PILOT_REPORT.md).
runtime_dependencies.node: All hooks and checkers are Node.js scripts (.mjs/.js/.cjs) started as `node` from PATH. No candidate declares a minimum version; Step 3 probes and this pilot used Node v26.13.0.
runtime_dependencies.dotnet_sdk: .NET SDK 10 (all six target net10.0 with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true); checkers call `dotnet` for MSBuild evaluation; CP-01 used SDK 10.0.403.
runtime_dependencies.git: Hooks and checkers call `git` (status/diff/ls-files) for change detection; Git commit/push gating needs a work tree.
runtime_dependencies.shell: PreToolUse hooks are registered for both Bash and PowerShell tool names.
runtime_dependencies.network: None needed by the hooks themselves; package restore by an agent needs a feed (benchmark-level decision).

immutability.read_only_attribute: set on every released file after verification (a guard, not a security boundary)
immutability.git: no commit, tag, branch, push or reset was made (the 5.4 folder is not a Git repository)
